name: AD843
tagline: ADI's 34 MHz, 250 V/µs CBFET single. A Soomal study called it the only OPA627 rival, and smoother; Head-Fi is split.

reputation.summary: A niche cult part with split opinion. A 2005 Soomal/DiyEden translation of an English headphone-amp study named it the only op-amp to rival the OPA627: smoother, slightly less resolving, with 'boldness, charm, vitality and passion', at half the price. It rated AD845 below and AD8610 above it. Head-Fi is reportedly mostly negative: harsh, bad offset, oscillation. No objective measurements found.
sonic_descriptors: bold, energetic (气魄、神韵、活力和热情)
typical_uses: Headphone amp op-amp rolling (CMoy-style single sockets)
DAC output stages, two on a dual adapter
caveats: High quiescent current (13 mA max, about 10.7 mA typ): runs warm, poor for battery amps.
Needs high supply (hobbyist minimums 8.2 V and 12.2 V); sound degrades as voltage drops.
Head-Fi reports bad offset and oscillation; a 34 MHz, 250 V/µs part is layout- and decoupling-sensitive.
Single only: dual sockets need two chips on an adapter.
SMD version is 16-pin SOIC (R-16), not SO-8; standard SO-8 adapters do not fit.

counterfeit_notes: No AD843 fakes reported (not specifically searched). Marketplace DIP JN/KN may be relabelled pulls. Iq should be 10–13 mA; much lower suggests a TL071-class die. Offset within 2 mV (J) or 1 mV (K). 8-pin SOIC 'AD843' is suspect.

claims_confirmed: Datasheet title '34 MHz, CBFET Fast Settling Op Amp', current revision Rev. D (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/AD843.pdf).
34 MHz bandwidth, 135 ns settling to 0.01% (10 V step), 0.6 nA bias (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/AD843.pdf).
Five grades: J/K 0 to +70 °C, A/B −40 to +85 °C, S −55 to +125 °C (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/AD843.pdf).
Connection diagrams show 16-pin SOIC (R-16) and 8-lead PDIP (N-8) (https://www.analog.com/static/imported-files/data_sheets/AD843.pdf).
Family in Production; AD843KNZ, AD843JRZ-16-REEL7, AD843SQ, AD843SQ/883B listed Production (https://analog.com/en/products/ad843.html).
Noise 19 nV/√Hz and 13 mA max supply, reportedly (https://datasheet.octopart.com/AD843KN-Analog-Devices-datasheet-7595.pdf).
AD843 Rev. D datasheet carries © Analog Devices 1995: https://www-cce.cldnet.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/AD843.pdf
Packages: 8-pin plastic DIP and cerdip, 16-pin SOIC, 20-pin LCC, 12-pin metal can; full-power bandwidth 3.9 MHz: https://www.radiolocman.com/datasheet/pdf.html?di=121483
